description: The selftest site's state targets for the styles mode (tests/harness/states.json has the site's; tests/README.md, Tokens and states). The styles controls in controls.json add the state rules.

targets.why: an inline link inside a paragraph: the pointer states and a real Tab
a text input, focused by focus()
two matches of one selector, both replayed
a scope of 20 elements, for the state coverage rule (control state-coverage)
a link below the fold: its focus(), first, scrolls the page from the top, and a Tab from #near back, which other.html's spy counts (control scroll-smooth)
